items.summary: Recommendation: maintain containment-only execution, reject new production or prototype admissions, and preserve only the already-queued allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement after one slot clears. September AI spend is $997.4992 across 5,521 calls, while Amazon evidence covers only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission, of which $0 is site-attributed. A fleet contribution margin is not calculable because infrastructure, domain, labor, and other operating costs are absent, and the revenue and AI-cost windows do not align. Do not forecast ROI, revenue lift, or causal impact.

After capacity release, execute only the existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement. Treat it as a learning experiment, not an approved revenue investment: incremental cost-to-learn is unknown because experiment-level AI, infrastructure, and labor cost attribution is unavailable. Record the existing baseline of 61 Amazon clicks, 0 ordered items, and $0 site-attributed commission for 2026-09-21; do not claim margin improvement or ROI.
